_about: Literals the surface wrappers would wrap that are NOT text a person reads in their language, so they stay as written (scripts/i18n-literals.mjs, run by `npm run i18n`). Each entry: surface, file (repo path, or /regex/), optional text (exact, or /regex/; placeholders as the wrapper prints them: %@ Apple, %s Android, {0} elsewhere), and why. Keep it short: user-facing text goes in i18n/<surface>/ instead. An entry that matches nothing fails the check, so the list cannot rot.
